headline: FireWorldBench tests multimodal models on coupled-field fire dynamics
summary: A September 19 preprint introduces FireWorldBench, a multimodal benchmark for reasoning about fire dynamics across temperature, visibility, smoke, flow, combustion and ventilation. It contains 520 fire-world entries—494 controlled simulations and 26 real-world-aligned event groups—with 9,074 question-answer items. The authors evaluate text-only structured observations and rendered physical-field visualizations; they report that leading models remain substantially less accurate on visual evidence and higher-order causal/intervention tasks than on simpler physical-perception tasks. These results are author-reported and the real-world-aligned component is limited to 26 event groups.
